exact_prompt:
I'm shopping for cottage cheese in the United States.

Which brand would you recommend for a high-protein snack, and why?
reviewed_answer:
My top pick is Good Culture 2% Milkfat Simply Cottage Cheese for a high-protein snack: it delivers about 14 g of protein per 1/2-cup serving while keeping the ingredient list simple, and it is widely available in U.S. grocery stores.

Why Good Culture

Strong protein density: 14 g per half cup makes it an easy way to add protein without a large snack.

Simple formulation: Its “Simply” line is a good fit if you prefer fewer additives than some flavored or high-protein cottage cheeses.

Balanced texture and taste: It has also performed well in taste comparisons, which matters if you plan to eat it plain or with fruit.

Good alternatives
Brand	Best for	Protein noted
Good Culture 2% Simply	Overall high-protein everyday snack	14 g per 1/2 cup 

Daisy 4%	Classic taste and simple ingredients	13 g per 1/2 cup 

Clover Sonoma Organic	Organic preference	14 g per 1/2 cup 

Breakstone’s Live Active Low-Fat	Portable single-serve cups	12 g per serving 
Practical choice

For the highest protein per bite, choose Good Culture 2% Simply; for the most convenient grab-and-go option, choose Breakstone’s single-serve cups. If sodium is a concern, compare labels because cottage cheese can be relatively salty, and consider a no-salt-added variety such as Friendship Dairies 1% Small Curd, which lists 15 g protein with much lower sodium per serving.
